title: Shifted work-tape head positions
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input string, and let $d$ be a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and record states. For natural numbers $t$ and $s$, the shifted configuration preserves all data except the work-tape head positions: the head on the table tape is moved by $t$, the head on the summary tape is moved by $s$, and every other work-tape head remains in place.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a finite Boolean input string
$d$ is a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes over Boolean symbols and record states
caveat: The supplied context does not identify which work tapes are the table tape and summary tape.
